```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
```

```{r load-globals, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/colors_themes.R"))
source(here::here("R/rf_functions.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils.R"))
```

```{r load-rds, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mg            <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/mg.rds"))
mg_rar        <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/mg_rar.rds"))
mg_un_curto   <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/mg_un_curto.rds"))
metadata      <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/metadata_final.rds"))
count_summary <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/count_summary.rds"))
clim_vars_PC  <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/clim_vars_PC.rds"))
litter_vars   <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/litter_vars.rds"))
plots_rf_ra   <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/plots_rf_ra.rds"))
```

### Alpha Diversity Plots

```{r alpha-diversity, fig.width=30, fig.height=14, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}
curto_unrar_otutab <- as.data.frame(t(mg_un_curto@otu_table))

alpha_diversity_table <- calc_alpha_diversity(
  otu_table      = curto_unrar_otutab,
  n_iterations   = 100,
  sequence_depth = 1900,
  set_seed       = 711
)

curto_divdf <- cbind(alpha_diversity_table, mg_rar@sam_data)

mean(curto_divdf$Richness)
sd(curto_divdf$Richness)
sd(curto_divdf$Richness) / sqrt(length(curto_divdf$Richness))

curto_shan <- ggplot(data = curto_divdf, aes(x = Litter_type, y = Shannon, fill = Litter_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() + geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge()) +
  facet_grid(~ reserve_code, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Litter type") +
  xlab("Litter type") + ggtitle("Alpha diversity for Curtobacterium strains in Leaf litter") +
  apatheme +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17), panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(curto_shan)

curto_shan_EcosysPT <- ggplot(data = curto_divdf, aes(x = Plant_type, y = Shannon, fill = Plant_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() + geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge()) +
  facet_grid(~ Ecosystem, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Litter type") +
  xlab("Litter type") + ggtitle("Alpha diversity for Curtobacterium strains in Leaf litter") +
  apatheme +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17), panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(curto_shan_EcosysPT)

hist(curto_divdf$Shannon)

# ANOVA
shann_anova   <- car::Anova(aov(Shannon ~ Ecosystem + Plant_type,   data = curto_divdf), type = "III")
shann_anova
shann_anova_2 <- car::Anova(aov(Shannon ~ Ecosystem * Litter_type,  data = curto_divdf), type = "III")
shann_anova_2

# Shannon vs environmental variables
for (variable in colnames(curto_divdf)[c(6:25, 36:40)]) {
  curto_shann_VS_vars_plot <- ggplot(data = curto_divdf,
                                     aes(x = !!sym(variable), y = Shannon, color = Litter_type)) +
    geom_smooth(aes(color = Litter_type), method = "lm") +
    stat_regline_equation(aes(label = paste(..adj.rr.label.., sep = "~~~~")),
                          position = "jitter", label.y = Inf) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    labs(y = "Shannon diversity index") +
    apatheme + theme(text = element_text(size = 16))
  print(curto_shann_VS_vars_plot)
  ggsave(filename = paste(here::here("plots/linear_regression/shannon_curto_Ab_vs"),
                          variable, "png", sep = "."),
         width = 30, height = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 320)
}

# PDP with alpha diversity (strain level)
curto_divdf <- curto_divdf |>
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") |>
  left_join(count_summary |> dplyr::select(c(SampleID, starts_with("PC"))), by = "SampleID")

set.seed(711)
shannon_res <- cached(here::here("cache/shannon_res.rds"), {
  run_rf_analysis(
    df           = curto_divdf,
    response_var = "Shannon",
    predictors   = c(clim_vars_PC, litter_vars),
    ntree = 1000, cv_folds = 10, nperm_oob = 1000, nrep_vi = 500, n_boot = 100, grid.size = 20)
})

shannon_res$rf_full; shannon_res$oob_error; shannon_res$A3_res
shannon_res$summary_table; shannon_res$pval_cv

write.table(shannon_res$summary_table,
            file = here::here("plots/RF_validation_shannon.csv"),
            quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = T, sep = ",")

plots_rf_shann <- generate_plots(
  imp_results_rf = shannon_res$imp_results_rf, pdp_ci_df = shannon_res$pdp_ci_df,
  rug = shannon_res$rug, clim_vars_PC, litter_vars, allvars_pallete,
  cv_r2 = shannon_res$CV_r2, apatheme, pval_cv = shannon_res$pval_cv,
  sig_vars = shannon_res$sig_vars_rfp, response_label = "Shannon")

shannon_PDP_CIs <- plots_rf_shann$pdp_plot_rf + scale_y_continuous()
shannon_PDP_imp <- plots_rf_shann$imp_plot_pdp_rf + scale_x_continuous()

curto_Shann_PDP_plot <- ggarrange(shannon_PDP_CIs, shannon_PDP_imp,
                                  labels = "AUTO", ncol = 2, common.legend = F,
                                  widths = c(1.75, 0.65), hjust = -0.2)
print(curto_Shann_PDP_plot)
ggsave(filename = here::here("plots/plots_pdp/pdp_plot_rf_ShannonDiv_clim_litt_vars_Sig_varsCIs.png"),
       width = 250, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 300, device = "png", type = "cairo-png")

#### Alpha diversity at the subclade level ####

subclades_unrar_otutab <- tax_glom(mg_un_curto, taxrank = "subclade")
subclades_unrar_otutab <- as.data.frame(t(subclades_unrar_otutab@otu_table))

alpha_diversity_table_sub <- calc_alpha_diversity(
  otu_table = subclades_unrar_otutab, n_iterations = 100, sequence_depth = 1900, set_seed = 711)

subclades_divdf <- cbind(alpha_diversity_table_sub, mg_rar@sam_data)

curto_shan_sub <- ggplot(data = subclades_divdf, aes(x = Litter_type, y = Shannon, fill = Litter_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() + geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge()) +
  facet_grid(~ reserve_code, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Litter type") + xlab("Litter type") +
  ggtitle("Alpha diversity for Curtobacterium Subclades in Leaf litter") +
  apatheme +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17), panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(curto_shan_sub)

curto_shan_EcosysPT_sub <- ggplot(data = subclades_divdf, aes(x = Plant_type, y = Shannon, fill = Plant_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() + geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge()) +
  facet_grid(~ Ecosystem, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Litter type") + xlab("Litter type") +
  ggtitle("Alpha diversity for Curtobacterium strains in Leaf litter") +
  apatheme +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17), panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(curto_shan_EcosysPT_sub)

shann_anova_sub   <- car::Anova(aov(Shannon ~ Ecosystem + Plant_type,  data = subclades_divdf), type = "III")
shann_anova_sub
shann_anova_2_sub <- car::Anova(aov(Shannon ~ Ecosystem * Litter_type, data = subclades_divdf), type = "III")
shann_anova_2_sub

for (variable in colnames(subclades_divdf)[c(6:25, 36:40)]) {
  curto_shann_VS_vars_plot <- ggplot(data = curto_divdf,
                                     aes(x = !!sym(variable), y = Shannon, color = Litter_type)) +
    geom_smooth(aes(color = Litter_type), method = "lm") +
    stat_regline_equation(aes(label = paste(..adj.rr.label.., sep = "~~~~")),
                          position = "jitter", label.y = Inf) +
    geom_point(size = 4) + labs(y = "Shannon diversity index") +
    apatheme + theme(text = element_text(size = 16))
  print(curto_shann_VS_vars_plot)
  ggsave(filename = paste(here::here("plots/linear_regression/shannon_curto_subclades_vs"),
                          variable, "png", sep = "."),
         width = 30, height = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 320)
}

subclades_divdf <- subclades_divdf |>
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") |>
  left_join(count_summary |> dplyr::select(c(SampleID, starts_with("PC"))), by = "SampleID")

set.seed(711)
shannon_res_sub <- cached(here::here("cache/shannon_res_sub.rds"), {
  run_rf_analysis(
    df = subclades_divdf, response_var = "Shannon",
    predictors = c(clim_vars_PC, litter_vars),
    ntree = 1000, cv_folds = 10, nperm_oob = 1000, nrep_vi = 500, n_boot = 100, grid.size = 20)
})

shannon_res_sub$rf_full; shannon_res_sub$oob_error; shannon_res_sub$A3_res
shannon_res_sub$summary_table; shannon_res_sub$pval_cv

write.table(shannon_res_sub$summary_table,
            file = here::here("plots/RF_validation_shannon_subclades.csv"),
            quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = T, sep = ",")

plots_rf_shann_sub <- generate_plots(
  imp_results_rf = shannon_res_sub$imp_results_rf, pdp_ci_df = shannon_res_sub$pdp_ci_df,
  rug = shannon_res_sub$rug, clim_vars_PC, litter_vars, allvars_pallete,
  cv_r2 = shannon_res_sub$CV_r2, apatheme, pval_cv = shannon_res_sub$pval_cv,
  sig_vars = shannon_res_sub$sig_vars_rfp, response_label = "Shannon")

shannon_PDP_CIs_sub <- plots_rf_shann_sub$pdp_plot_rf + scale_y_continuous()
shannon_PDP_imp_sub <- plots_rf_shann_sub$imp_plot_pdp_rf + scale_x_continuous()

curto_Shann_PDP_plot_sub <- ggarrange(shannon_PDP_CIs_sub, shannon_PDP_imp_sub,
                                      labels = "AUTO", ncol = 2, common.legend = F,
                                      widths = c(1.75, 0.65), hjust = -0.2)
print(curto_Shann_PDP_plot_sub)
ggsave(filename = here::here("plots/plots_pdp/pdp_plot_rf_ShannonDiv_Subclades_clim_litt_vars_Sig_varsCIs.png"),
       width = 250, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 300, device = "png", type = "cairo-png")
```

#### GLM — Shannon diversity (strain level)

```{r glm-shannon-strain, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}
shannon_glm_res <- cached(here::here("cache/shannon_glm_res.rds"), {
  run_glm_analysis(
    df           = curto_divdf,
    response_var = "Shannon",
    predictors   = c(clim_vars_PC, litter_vars),
    cv_folds = 10, nrep_vi = 500, n_boot = 100, grid.size = 20)
})

shannon_glm_res$summary_table

write.table(shannon_glm_res$summary_table,
            file = here::here("plots/GLM_validation_shannon.csv"),
            quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = T, sep = ",")

plots_glm_shann <- generate_plots(
  imp_results_rf = shannon_glm_res$imp_results_rf,
  pdp_ci_df      = shannon_glm_res$pdp_ci_df,
  rug            = shannon_glm_res$rug,

  response_label = "Shannon")

shannon_GLM_PDP_CIs <- plots_glm_shann$pdp_plot_rf + scale_y_continuous()

curto_Shann_GLM_plot <- ggarrange(shannon_GLM_PDP_CIs, shannon_GLM_PDP_imp,

                                  widths = c(1.75, 0.65), hjust = -0.2)
print(curto_Shann_GLM_plot)
ggsave(filename = here::here("plots/plots_pdp/pdp_plot_glm_ShannonDiv_clim_litt_vars_Sig_varsCIs.png"),
       plot = curto_Shann_GLM_plot,
       width = 250, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 300, device = "png", type = "cairo-png")
```

##### Combined figure of PDPs for Relative abundance and Shannon diversity

```{r combined-pdp-ra-shannon}
final_RA_RF <- plots_rf_ra$pdp_plot_rf
final_RA_RF$layers <- final_RA_RF$layers[
  !sapply(plots_rf_ra$pdp_plot_rf$layers, function(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomRug"))]
final_RA_RF

m_pdp <- ggplot2::margin(0, 12, 0, 0)   # right gap after PDP panels
m_imp <- ggplot2::margin(0,  0, 0, 12)  # left gap before importance panels

p1 <- final_RA_RF +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(), plot.margin = m_pdp, panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines"),
        legend.position = "none")

p2 <- plots_rf_ra$imp_plot_pdp_rf +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), plot.margin = m_imp, panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines"),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(tag = NULL)

p3 <- shannon_PDP_CIs +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5), legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.margin = m_pdp, panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines"))

p4 <- shannon_PDP_imp +
  theme(plot.margin = m_imp, panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines")) + labs(tag = NULL)

aligned <- cowplot::align_plots(p1, p2, p3, p4, align = "hv", axis = "l")
cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = aligned, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(2, 1),
                   rel_heights = c(1, 1.1), labels = "AUTO")

cowplot::ggsave2(
  filename = here::here("plots/plots_pdp/pdp_plot_rf_RelAb_ShannonDiv_Subclades_clim_litt_vars_Sig_varsCIs_combined.png"),
  width = 280, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300, device = "png",
  type = "cairo-png", bg = "white")
```

```{r save-rds, include=FALSE}
saveRDS(subclades_divdf, here::here("results/rds/subclades_divdf.rds"))
```
